title: Silence detector: a source that stops sending is a finding

story.i_want_to: be told when a source that normally sends ledger rows goes quiet
story.so_that: an empty ledger never reads as nothing being wrong

rationale: Every other finding is derived from rows. A broken sender produces no rows and therefore no findings, which looks exactly like a healthy fleet.

acceptance_criteria.description: The sweep files a source_silent finding (fingerprint source id + host) for a (source, host) that sent rows on at least 3 of the previous 7 days and none in the last 24 hours, filed on the chg repository, where the sender lives.
It closes like any finding: rows from that (source, host) again for the quiet period close it.

test_cases.name: a quiet host is filed, a new host is not
preconditions: host a sent on 5 of 7 days, nothing today
expected_results: one source_silent finding, for host a
